{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
penguins = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/penguins.csv')

# Check how many rows have missing flipper_length_mm
missing_flipper = penguins['flipper_length_mm'].isnull().sum()
print(f'Missing flipper_length_mm values: {missing_flipper}')

# Check if missingness is random or systematic
# Look at species distribution among missing values
missing_by_species = penguins[penguins['flipper_length_mm'].isnull()]['species'].value_counts()
print('\nSpecies with missing flipper_length_mm:\n', missing_by_species)

# Compute mean flipper length by species, using .mean() which skips NaN
mean_flipper_by_species = penguins.groupby('species')['flipper_length_mm'].mean()
print('\nMean flipper length by species:\n', mean_flipper_by_species)

# Identify which species has the highest mean
highest_mean_species = mean_flipper_by_species.idxmax()
print(f'\nSpecies with highest mean flipper length: {highest_mean_species}')"}
